messages:
Maya: Morning — vuln-bot just flagged a lodash advisory that looks exploitable. CVE-2026-19753, CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.67. advisory: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-19753

vuln-bot: Automated alert: CVE-2026-19753 detected in package lodash (< 4.17.22). CVSS: 9.8, EPSS: 0.67, exploit maturity: public PoC. Affected modules: api-service (direct), data-ingest (transitive).

Kevin: Is lodash used directly in api-service only or do we have transitive pulls in analytics and infra images?

Maya: Scan shows direct in api-service@4.17.21, transitive via gulp in data-ingest, and in our base runtime image (node:14 -> includes older deps).

Eli: Quick options: upgrade to 4.17.22 (patch released), or apply npm audit fix + rebuild images. Given CVSS+EPSS and public PoC, I recommend P1 for internet-facing services.

Olivia: Can we hotfix api-service quickly? @SRE-Oncall do we have a canary window for a rapid rollout? Also note recent KMS key rotation — ensure secrets decrypt post-deploy.

SRE-Oncall: Canary window is free. I will run decrypt smoke for KMS first. If env decrypts, can do 10% -> 100% rollout.

Kevin: I'll open a PR to bump lodash to 4.17.22, run unit + staging e2e. ETA ~2h. Assigning myself as owner.

Maya: Assigned to Kevin. Please add security/patch label, include changelog entry, and run trace tests to ensure KV cache and decoding paths unaffected.

vuln-bot: Advisory details pinned to thread. Evidence: public PoC on GitHub linked in advisory. Recommendation: immediate upgrade for internet-facing endpoints.

Eli: Scoring recap for records: CVSS 9.8 / EPSS 0.67 / Exploitability: confirmed public PoC. Recommended remediation: upgrade packages + rebuild base images + staged rollout + 24h post-rollout monitoring. Marking RTO = 4h.

Maya: Action items: 1) Kevin PR + label security/urgent 2) SRE run canary and smoke tests 3) Infra to rebuild base images with patched deps 4) Compliance to log audit event: "security_patch_lodash" and update SBOMs.

Olivia: RBAC change not needed for this deploy, just deploy perms. I'll add a note to run KMS decrypt smoke because of Monday rotation.

SRE-Oncall: Ran KMS decrypt smoke on staging — KMS decryption OK. Started canary on staging (10% traffic). Health checks passing. :thumbsup:

Kevin: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/api-service/pull/4321 — bump lodash -> 4.17.22. CI green, tagging security/urgent. Requesting review from @Olivia and @Eli.

Maya: Nice. Once merged: roll out 10% -> 100% in 1h increments, monitor 5xx and latency. Add alert for sudden 5xx increase.

vuln-bot: Thread status: mitigation in progress. Will auto-close when all affected services report upgraded package versions and SBOMs are updated.
